```{r read ET model, warning=FALSE}
# model parent folder path
model_prefix <- paste0("../models/cor_scaled/")
fnames <- list.files(path=model_prefix)
print(fnames)

# read in models, get random effects for each participant, store in a df.
df <- data.frame()
for (f in fnames) {
  m <- read_rds(paste0(model_prefix, "/", f))
  # posterior_draws <- as_draws_df(m)
  # View(posterior_draws)
  mode <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][1]
  # print(mode)
  measure <- "gaze_duration"
  for (loc in c("spillover", "local")) {
    if (loc == "spillover") {
      posterior_correlations <- as_draws_df(m) %>%
        mutate(
          measure = measure,
          mode = mode,
          location = loc,
          cor_len = `cor_subj_id__c1:prev_len__c2:prev_len`,
          cor_freq = `cor_subj_id__c1:prev_freq__c2:prev_freq`,
          cor_surp = `cor_subj_id__c1:prev_surp__c2:prev_surp`
          ) %>%
        dplyr::select(measure, mode, location, cor_len, cor_freq, cor_surp)
    } else {
      posterior_correlations <- as_draws_df(m) %>%
        mutate(
          measure = measure,
          mode = mode,
          location = loc,
          cor_len = `cor_subj_id__c1:len__c2:len`,
          cor_freq = `cor_subj_id__c1:freq__c2:freq`,
          cor_surp = `cor_subj_id__c1:surp__c2:surp`
          ) %>%
        dplyr::select(measure, mode, location, cor_len, cor_freq, cor_surp)
    }
  df <- bind_rows(df, posterior_correlations)
  }
}
```

```{r PLOT functions}
posterior_corr_plot <- function(rho_df, colours, n_cols=6){
  rho_p <- ggplot(rho_df, aes(y = correlation, x=effect)) +
    stat_halfeye(
    aes(fill = effect_loc, fill_ramp = after_stat(level)),
    .width = c(.50, .80, .90),
    # NOTE: we use position = "dodgejust" (a dodge that respects the
    # justification of intervals relative to slabs) instead of
    # position = "dodge" here because it ensures the topmost slab does
    # not extend beyond the plot limits
    position = "dodgejust", normalize = "groups"
  ) +
  # a range from 1 down to 0.2 ensures the fill goes dark to light inside-out
  # and doesn't get all the way down to white (0) on the lightest color
  scale_fill_ramp_discrete(name = "Level:", na.translate = FALSE) + 
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x)
    stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 10))+
    scale_fill_manual(values=colours) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype="dashed", color = "grey51") +
    facet_grid(location ~ mode) + 
    # guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Predictor:", nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    xlab(NULL) + 
    ylab("Posterior Correlation Coefficient") +
    theme_light() +
    theme(
      legend.text=element_text(size=12),
      legend.title=element_text(size=12), 
      legend.position = "bottom",legend.direction = "horizontal",
      axis.title.y=element_text(size=13), axis.text.y=element_text(size=13), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, size=13, color = "black"),  # Rotate x-axis labels
      # axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),  # Increase facet label size
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray85", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"))  # Increase space between facets)
  return(rho_p)
}

shift_legend <- function(p){
  # check if p is a valid object
  if(!"gtable" %in% class(p)){
    if("ggplot" %in% class(p)){
      gp <- ggplotGrob(p) # convert to grob
    } else {
      message("This is neither a ggplot object nor a grob generated from ggplotGrob. Returning original plot.")
      return(p)
    }
  } else {
    gp <- p
  }

  # check for unfilled facet panels
  facet.panels <- grep("^panel", gp[["layout"]][["name"]])
  empty.facet.panels <- sapply(facet.panels, function(i) "zeroGrob" %in% class(gp[["grobs"]][[i]]))
  empty.facet.panels <- facet.panels[empty.facet.panels]
  if(length(empty.facet.panels) == 0){
    message("There are no unfilled facet panels to shift legend into. Returning original plot.")
    return(p)
  }

  # establish extent of unfilled facet panels (including any axis cells in between)
  empty.facet.panels <- gp[["layout"]][empty.facet.panels, ]
  empty.facet.panels <- list(min(empty.facet.panels[["t"]]), min(empty.facet.panels[["l"]]),
                             max(empty.facet.panels[["b"]]), max(empty.facet.panels[["r"]]))
  names(empty.facet.panels) <- c("t", "l", "b", "r")

  # extract legend & copy over to location of unfilled facet panels
  guide.grob <- which(gp[["layout"]][["name"]] == "guide-box")
  if(length(guide.grob) == 0){
    message("There is no legend present. Returning original plot.")
    return(p)
  }
  gp <- gtable_add_grob(x = gp,
                        grobs = gp[["grobs"]][[guide.grob]],
                        t = empty.facet.panels[["t"]],
                        l = empty.facet.panels[["l"]],
                        b = empty.facet.panels[["b"]],
                        r = empty.facet.panels[["r"]],
                        name = "new-guide-box")

  # squash the original guide box's row / column (whichever applicable)
  # & empty its cell
  guide.grob <- gp[["layout"]][guide.grob, ]
  if(guide.grob[["l"]] == guide.grob[["r"]]){
    gp <- gtable_squash_cols(gp, cols = guide.grob[["l"]])
  }
  if(guide.grob[["t"]] == guide.grob[["b"]]){
    gp <- gtable_squash_rows(gp, rows = guide.grob[["t"]])
  }
  gp <- gtable_remove_grobs(gp, "guide-box")

  return(gp)
}

create_et_plot <- function(rho_df){
  p_out <- posterior_corr_plot(rho_df, colours=my_cols, n_cols = 6)
  p_out <- shift_legend(p_out)
  return(p_out)
}
```

```{r Fixed Effect DF}
# model parent folder path
model_prefix <- paste0("../models/cor_scaled/")
fnames <- list.files(path=model_prefix)
print(fnames)

# read in models, get random effects for each participant, store in a df.
dff <- data.frame()

for (f in fnames) {
  m <- read_rds(paste0(model_prefix, "/", f))
  mode <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][1]
  measure <- "gaze_duration"

  posterior_draws <- as_draws_df(m)
  posterior_correlations <- posterior_draws %>%
    dplyr::select(b_c2, b_len, b_freq, b_surp,
                  b_prev_len, b_prev_freq, b_prev_surp) %>%
    rename(contr = b_c2,
           len = b_len,
           freq = b_freq,
           surp = b_surp,
           prev_len = b_prev_len,
           prev_freq = b_prev_freq,
           prev_surp = b_prev_surp) %>%
    mutate(measure = measure, mode = mode)

  dff <- bind_rows(dff, posterior_correlations)
}

# View(dff)

# write_csv(dff, "../results/stats/fixed_effect_local_spillover.csv")

dff_long <- dff %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(contr, len, freq, surp, prev_len, prev_freq, prev_surp),
               names_to = "predictor",
               values_to = "eff_size") %>%
  mutate(location = ifelse(predictor %in% c("prev_len", "prev_freq", "prev_surp"), "spillover", "local")) %>% 
  mutate(predictor = case_when(
    predictor == "prev_len" ~ "len",
    predictor == "prev_freq" ~ "freq",
    predictor == "prev_surp" ~ "surp",
    TRUE ~ predictor
  )) %>%
  mutate(predictor = factor(predictor,
                         levels = c("len", "freq", "surp", "contr"),
                         labels = c("Word Len.", "Lex. Freq.", "Surprisal", "Reading Context")),
          mode = factor(mode,
                        levels = c("indicos", "potec", "onestop", "geconl", "gecozh", "hkc"),
                        labels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")),
         location = factor(location,
                           levels = c("spillover", "local"),
                           labels = c("Spillover", "Local"))
          )

```

```{r Spillover data prep 1}
# model parent folder path
model_prefix <- paste0("../models/cor_scaled/")
fnames <- list.files(path=model_prefix)
print(fnames)

# read in models, get random effects for each participant, store in a df.
df <- data.frame()

for (f in fnames) {
  m <- read_rds(paste0(model_prefix, "/", f))
  mode <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][1]
  measure <- "gaze_duration"

  ran <- ranef(m)
  ran_subj <- ran[["subj_id"]]
  random_eff <- as.data.frame(ran_subj[, , 1:14]) %>%
    dplyr::select(`Estimate.c1`, `Estimate.c2`, `Estimate.c1:len`, `Estimate.c2:len`, `Estimate.c1:freq`, `Estimate.c2:freq`, `Estimate.c1:surp`, `Estimate.c2:surp`, `Estimate.c1:prev_len`, `Estimate.c2:prev_len`, `Estimate.c1:prev_freq`, `Estimate.c2:prev_freq`, `Estimate.c1:prev_surp`, `Estimate.c2:prev_surp`) %>%
    rename(r_int_c1 = `Estimate.c1`,
           r_int_c2 = `Estimate.c2`,
           r_len_c1 = `Estimate.c1:len`,
           r_len_c2 = `Estimate.c2:len`,
           r_freq_c1 = `Estimate.c1:freq`,
           r_freq_c2 = `Estimate.c2:freq`,
           r_surp_c1 = `Estimate.c1:surp`,
           r_surp_c2 = `Estimate.c2:surp`,
           r_prev_len_c1 = `Estimate.c1:prev_len`,
           r_prev_len_c2 = `Estimate.c2:prev_len`,
           r_prev_freq_c1 = `Estimate.c1:prev_freq`,
           r_prev_freq_c2 = `Estimate.c2:prev_freq`,
           r_prev_surp_c1 = `Estimate.c1:prev_surp`,
           r_prev_surp_c2 = `Estimate.c2:prev_surp`
           ) %>%
    mutate(measure = measure, mode = mode) %>%
    rownames_to_column("subj_id")
   # View(random_eff)
  df <- bind_rows(df, random_eff)
}
```

```{r Spillover data prep 2, eval=FALSE}
csv_prefix <- paste0("../data/fit_input")

  print(f)
  mode <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(f)

    filter(measures %in% c("FPReg", "skip")) %>%
    dplyr::select(subj_id, subj, trial, word_id, c1, c2, measures, value) %>%

  ) %>%
```

```{r Frequentist Spillover & reading pattern data, warning=FALSE}
sum_stats <- read.csv("../results/stats/participants_reading_pattern_sum.csv")
df <- read.csv("../results/stats/participants_random_effects_scaled.csv")

reff_df <- df %>%
  mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(subj_id, mode, r_surp_c1, r_surp_c2, r_prev_surp_c1, r_prev_surp_c2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(r_surp_c1, r_surp_c2, r_prev_surp_c1, r_prev_surp_c2),
    names_to = c(".value", "contr"),
    names_pattern = "r_(prev_surp|surp)_(c\\d)"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    spillover = prev_surp,
    local = surp
  )
# View(reff_df)

sum_stats <- sum_stats %>% mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = measures,
    values_from = mean_value
  ) %>%
  mutate(mode = if_else(mode == "et_indico", "indicos", mode))
  
# View(sum_stats)

subj_df <- left_join(reff_df, sum_stats, by = c("mode", "subj_id", "contr")) %>%
  rename(Spillover = spillover,
         Contrast = contr) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(local, skip, FPReg),
    names_to = "measures",
    values_to = "Rate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(mode = factor(mode,
                        levels = c("indicos", "potec", "onestop", "geconl", "gecozh", "hkc"),
                        labels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")),
         measures = factor(measures,
                           levels = c("local", "skip", "FPReg"),
                           labels = c("Local Effect", "Skip Rate", "Regression Rate"))) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(!measures %in% c("Local Effect")) #%>%
  # filter(! mode %in% c("GECO-ZH", "HKC") )
  # filter(! mode %in% c("GECO-ZH", "OneStop"))
  # filter(mode %in% c( "HKC"))
subj_df
```

```{r Frequentist Spillover & reading pattern Plot, warning=FALSE}
corr_labels <- subj_df %>%
  group_by(mode, measures, Contrast) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(Spillover, Rate, use = "complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(Spillover, Rate)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      p <= 0.1   ~ "",
      TRUE             ~ ""
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("r = ", round(r, 2), " ", sig),
    x_pos = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", -Inf, Inf),
    y_pos = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", Inf, -Inf),
    hjust_val = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", -0.1, 1.1),
    vjust_val = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", 1.5, -0.5)
  )

# View(corr_labels)
# write_csv(corr_labels, "../results/stats/behavior_cor_surp_frequentist.csv")

subj_df %>% 
  # filter(effect == "Word Length") %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = Spillover, y = Rate, color = Contrast)) +
  #   geom_line(
  #   aes(group = subj_id),
  #   color = "gray50",
  #   linetype = "dashed",
  #   linewidth = 0.4,
  #   alpha = 0.4
  # ) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(measures), cols = vars(mode), scales = "free") +
  geom_text(
    data = corr_labels,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label, color = Contrast, hjust = hjust_val, vjust = vjust_val),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("c1" = "#1b9e77", "c2" = "#d95f02")) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
  xlab("Spillover Effect Size (Surprisal)") +
  ylab("Rate or Effect Size") +
  theme_light(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray85", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r Bayesian Spillover vs local effect}
# model parent folder path
model_prefix <- paste0("../models/cor_scaled/")
fnames <- list.files(path=model_prefix)
print(fnames)

# read in models, get random effects for each participant, store in a df.
dff <- data.frame()
for (f in fnames) {
    m <- read_rds(paste0(model_prefix, "/", f))
    mode <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][1]
    measure <- "gaze_duration"
    posterior_correlations <- as_draws_df(m) %>%
      mutate(
        measure = measure,
        mode = mode,
        cor_slc1_len = `cor_subj_id__c1:len__c1:prev_len`,
        cor_slc2_len = `cor_subj_id__c2:len__c2:prev_len`,
        cor_slc1_freq = `cor_subj_id__c1:freq__c1:prev_freq`,
        cor_slc2_freq = `cor_subj_id__c2:freq__c2:prev_freq`,
        cor_slc1_surp = `cor_subj_id__c1:surp__c1:prev_surp`,
        cor_slc2_surp = `cor_subj_id__c2:surp__c2:prev_surp`
        ) %>%
      dplyr::select(measure, mode, cor_slc1_len,  cor_slc2_len, cor_slc1_freq, cor_slc2_freq, cor_slc1_surp, cor_slc2_surp)
  dff <- bind_rows(dff, posterior_correlations)
}
```

```{r Bayesian Spillover vs Behaviorial pattern data prep, warning=FALSE}
sum_stats <- read.csv("../results/stats/participants_reading_pattern_sum.csv")
df <- read.csv("../results/stats/participants_random_effects_scaled.csv")

reff_df <- df %>%
  mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(subj_id, mode, r_prev_len_c1, r_prev_len_c2, r_prev_freq_c1, r_prev_freq_c2,  r_prev_surp_c1, r_prev_surp_c2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(r_prev_len_c1, r_prev_len_c2, r_prev_freq_c1, r_prev_freq_c2,  r_prev_surp_c1, r_prev_surp_c2),
    names_to = "contr",
    values_to = "spillover"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effect = str_extract(contr, "(?<=r_prev_)[a-z]+"),
    contr = case_when(
      str_ends(contr, "_c1") ~ "c1",
      str_ends(contr, "_c2") ~ "c2",
      TRUE ~ contr
    )
  )


reff_local <- df %>%
  mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(subj_id, mode, r_len_c1, r_len_c2, r_freq_c1, r_freq_c2,  r_surp_c1, r_surp_c2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(r_len_c1, r_len_c2, r_freq_c1, r_freq_c2,  r_surp_c1, r_surp_c2),
    names_to = "contr",
    values_to = "local"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effect = str_extract(contr, "(?<=r_)[a-z]+"),
    contr = case_when(
      str_ends(contr, "_c1") ~ "c1",
      str_ends(contr, "_c2") ~ "c2",
      TRUE ~ contr
    )
  )

reff <- left_join(reff_df, reff_local, by = c("subj_id", "mode", "contr", "effect"))

sum_stats <- sum_stats %>% mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = measures,
    values_from = mean_value
  ) %>%
  mutate(mode = if_else(mode == "et_indico", "indicos", mode))

subj_df <- left_join(reff, sum_stats, by = c("mode", "subj_id", "contr")) %>%
  rename(Spillover = spillover,
         Contrast = contr) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(local, skip, FPReg),
    names_to = "measures",
    values_to = "Rate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(mode = factor(mode,
                        levels = c("indicos", "potec", "onestop", "geconl", "gecozh", "hkc"),
                        labels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")),
         measures = factor(measures,
                           levels = c("skip", "FPReg", "local"),
                           labels = c("Skip Rate", "Regression Rate", "Local Effect")),
         effect = factor(effect, 
                         levels = c("len", "freq", "surp"),
                         labels = c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal"))
         ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  drop_na()
View(subj_df)
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
modes <- c("InDiCo", "PoTeC")
measures <- c("Skip Rate", "Regression Rate")
effects <- c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal")

for (mod in modes) {
  for (meas in measures) {
    for (eff in effects) {
      print(paste0("Fit models for ", mod, " ", meas, " ", eff))
      temp <- subj_df %>% 
        filter(mode == mod, measures == meas, effect == eff) %>%
        dplyr::select(Spillover, Rate)
      temp_data = list(x=temp, N=nrow(temp))
      model = stan(
        file="../stan_models/bivariate_correlation.stan", 
        data=temp_data, 
        iter=4000, 
        chains=4, 
        cores=4,
        seed=444,
        control=list(adapt_delta=0.99),
        verbose = FALSE
        )
      # model@stanmodel@dso <- new("cxxdso")
      saveRDS(model, file = paste0("../models/behavior/", mod, "_", eff,"_spillover_",meas, ".rds"))
      
      for (c in c("c1", "c2")) {
        tmp <- subj_df %>%
          filter(mode == mod, measures == meas, effect == eff, Contrast == c) %>%
          dplyr::select(Spillover, Rate)
        tmp_data = list(x=tmp, N=nrow(tmp))
        model = stan(
          file="../stan_models/bivariate_correlation.stan",
          data=tmp_data,
          iter=4000,
          chains=4,
          cores=4,
          seed=444,
          control=list(adapt_delta=0.99),
          verbose = FALSE
          )
        # model@stanmodel@dso <- new("cxxdso")
        saveRDS(model, file = paste0("../models/behavior/", mod, "_", eff,"_spillover_", meas, "_", c, ".rds"))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
model_prefix <- paste0("../models/behavior/")
fnames <- list.files(path=model_prefix)
# print(fnames)

# read in models, get random effects for each participant, store in a df.
df <- data.frame()
for (f in fnames) {
    m <- read_rds(paste0(model_prefix, "/", f))
    mode <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][1]
    effect <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][2]
    measures <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][4]
    contr <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][5]
    sum <- summary(m, pars = c("rho"))$summary
    rho_stats <- sum["rho", c("mean", "2.5%", "97.5%")]
    row <- tibble(
    mode = mode,
    effect = effect,
    measures = measures,
    contr = contr,
    rho_mean = rho_stats["mean"],
    rho_lower = rho_stats["2.5%"],
    rho_upper = rho_stats["97.5%"]
  )
  df <- rbind(df, row)
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    contr = case_when(
      contr == "c1.rds" ~ "c1",
      contr == "c2.rds" ~ "c2",
      TRUE ~ "all"
    ),
    measures = str_remove(measures, "\\.rds$")
  )

model_prefix <- paste0("../models/cor_scaled/")
fnames <- list.files(path=model_prefix)
print(fnames)

# read in models, get random effects for each participant, store in a df.
local_df <- data.frame()
for (f in fnames) {
    m <- read_rds(paste0(model_prefix, "/", f))
    mode <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][1]
    posterior_correlations <- as_draws_df(m) %>%
      mutate(
        mode = mode,
        measures = "Local Effect",
        cor_c1_len = `cor_subj_id__c1:len__c1:prev_len`,
        cor_c2_len = `cor_subj_id__c2:len__c2:prev_len`,
        cor_c1_freq = `cor_subj_id__c1:freq__c1:prev_freq`,
        cor_c2_freq = `cor_subj_id__c2:freq__c2:prev_freq`,
        cor_c1_surp = `cor_subj_id__c1:surp__c1:prev_surp`,
        cor_c2_surp = `cor_subj_id__c2:surp__c2:prev_surp`,
        ) %>%
      dplyr::select(mode, measures, cor_c1_len, cor_c2_len, cor_c1_freq, cor_c2_freq, cor_c1_surp, cor_c2_surp)
  local_df <- bind_rows(local_df, posterior_correlations)
}

local_sum <- local_df %>%
  group_by(mode, measures) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      .cols = c(cor_c1_len, cor_c2_len, cor_c1_freq, cor_c2_freq, cor_c1_surp, cor_c2_surp),
      .fns = list(
        mean = mean,
        lower = ~ quantile(.x, 0.025),
        upper = ~ quantile(.x, 0.975)
        # lower = ~ hdi(.x, credMass = 0.95)[1],
        # upper = ~ hdi(.x, credMass = 0.95)[2]
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% pivot_longer(
    cols = 3:20,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    parts = str_split(variable, "_", simplify = TRUE),
    contr = parts[, 2],
    effect = parts[, 3],
    stat = paste0("rho_", parts[, 4])
  ) %>%
  mutate(mode = factor(mode,
                        levels = c("indicos", "potec", "onestop", "geconl", "gecozh", "hkc"),
                        labels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")),
         effect = factor(effect, 
                         levels = c("len", "freq", "surp"),
                         labels = c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(mode, measures, contr, effect, stat, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stat,
    values_from = value
  )
  
behavior <- bind_rows(df, local_sum) %>%
    mutate(mode = factor(mode,
                        levels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC"),
                        labels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")),
         measures = factor(measures,
                           levels = c("Skip Rate", "Regression Rate", "Local Effect"),
                           labels = c("Skip Rate", "Regression Rate", "Local Effect")),
         effect = factor(effect, 
                         levels = c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal"),
                         labels = c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal"))
         ) %>%
  arrange(mode, measures, effect, contr) %>% 
  rename(Contrast = contr) %>%
  mutate(
    annotation = sprintf(
      "hat(rho) == %.2f*\"[\"*%.2f*\",\" ~ %.2f*\"]\"",
      rho_mean, rho_lower, rho_upper
    ),
    x_pos = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", -Inf, Inf),
    y_pos = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", Inf, -Inf),
    hjust_val = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", -0.05, 1.05),
    vjust_val = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", 1.1, -0.1)
  ) %>% filter(Contrast != "all")
```
